rule.description: One class has directly absorbed several unrelated responsibilities: it defines a large body of its own methods whose implementation helpers split into three or more mutually disjoint responsibility clusters - groups of private helpers that share the instance-attribute bank they own and call one another, with no attribute or call edge between groups - while public flow methods interleave all of them.

checks.description: Detect a class that owns several disjoint clusters of responsibility-implementation helpers, each cluster mutating its own instance-attribute bank, with the class's public methods interleaving every cluster.
checks.detected_relation: VecEnv (the transport base class shared by every vectorized-environment backend) -> three disjoint clusters it directly implements: observation stacking, running-statistics normalization (numpy and TF variants), and episode accounting with results-file export.
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The class that defines the transport abstraction for all backends also owns the state, numerics and I/O of three unrelated rollout concerns that previously had dedicated owners and that change for different reasons; every backend constructor forwards blanket options into it and the public reset/step pipeline interleaves all three concerns in one fixed order.

matches.evidence: class "VecEnv" directly implements 3 disjoint responsibility clusters (own methods: 26, own statements: 165; clusters: _close_results_writer+_init_results_writer+_record_episodes+_write_results_row [mutated state: epcount,eplens,eprets,results_file,results_writer]; _combine_moments+_filter_obs+_init_normalization_state+_init_tf_stat_variables+_normalize_step_results+_sync_tf_stats+_update_running_stats [mutated state: _ob_stats,_ret_stats,_tf_sess,ret]; _stack_frames+_stack_reset [mutated state: stackedobs])

excluded: VecEnvWrapper and VecEnvObservationWrapper (baselines/common/vec_env/vec_env.py): thin forwarding bases whose helpers do not split into mutually disjoint attribute-owning clusters; not reported.
DummyVecEnv, SubprocVecEnv, ShmemVecEnv (baselines/common/vec_env/): concrete transports whose private hook methods form a single interaction cluster with one shared attribute bank; not reported.

baselines/common/tf_util.py emits an unrelated E0011 unrecognized-inline-option message caused by a stale '# pylint: ignore-module' pragma in every checked repository state; the checker ignores any message outside the rule symbol.

Dense model/policy-construction functions (e.g. baselines/common/models.py, baselines/policies.py): large method bodies that share one purpose and one state surface rather than three or more disjoint clusters; not reported.
